pages.title: A mantle from another world
pages.text: “Once, clothes protected me from cold, rain, and danger. Now I wear gear made for one who no longer belongs to the ordinary world.”$(br2)The Cloak of the Beyond is the chest piece of the set.

pages.title: Between life and death
pages.text: After returning to your normal state, the first hit you take is ignored completely. In $(l:beginning/spirit_form)Spirit Form$(/l), your first hit deals ten times as much damage. Afterwards, Spirit Form cannot be activated for $(thing)10 seconds$().
